ILLUSTRATIVE WORKFLOW
THE COMPLETE WORKFLOW

Every handoff has a place.

A planned workflow for reception, the laboratory, reviewers, and accounts—connected around the patient.

01

Register & refer

Find patients by name, phone, or ID; create a record and associate the referring doctor.

02

Order & bill

Select tests and panels, issue an invoice, record a partial or full payment, and follow dues.

03

Collect & process

Label applicable specimens, track collection and rejection, and prepare results. Imaging without specimens skips collection.

04

Review & release

A different authorized staff member verifies results before release and branded PDF printing.

05

Settle & close

Record remaining payments and reconcile daily collections and cash.

✳

Reception creates the order and records payments; collectors handle specimens; technicians enter results; reviewers verify and release; accountants close the day. Administrators manage permissions.
